request: Sixty-first build (incremental on the sixtieth, run 43527235720), for MoltShield's vendored Rust crates. The adblock crates aren't committed in src/: every test build vendors them with gnrt on the runner and throws the result away, and a Mac build (the owner's v0.3.0 release, or a test build) has to vendor them itself first. With vendor_dump, stage 1 runs vendor-rust-crates.sh with its copy-back and prints what changed under src/third_party/rust into its log, so the tree can be committed (tools/ci/molt_vendored_from_log.py). No tests: only stage 1's overlay step matters here.
